_status: PROVISIONAL - not yet derived from measured cross-platform spreads. Used only when the baseline was produced on a different platform/backend build; the same platform must match the baseline byte for byte. Replace with measured values (compare_platforms.py) before release.
_meaning: abs: absolute limit; rel: relative limit; a value passes if it is within either. A3/A4 are compared only where I3/I4 exceed min_amplitude; alpha is not compared for nearly round isophotes (ellip < min_ellip).
